label: Notion: Create Page
description: Create a page under a parent page, with plain text (one paragraph per line) or raw Notion blocks as its body. Emits the new page's id and link.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Notion access (wire a NotionAccess node).

inputs.name: parentPage
inputs.label: Parent page
inputs.placeholder: Paste the parent page's link or id
inputs.description: The page the new page is created under (the connection must have access to it).

inputs.name: content
inputs.description: Plain-text body: one paragraph per line.

inputs.name: blocks
inputs.description: Raw Notion block objects; overrides content when set.
